[Added]
- Added version support upto 2.26.46.xx
- Custom Emojis: Choose from cloud emoji styles (iOS, Facebook, Samsung, Twitter, Windows, etc.) with in-app download and management screen
- Report Issue Feature: Report issues and suggest features within app
- Added option to show/hide message notifications for locked chats
- Added Native Floating Navigation: turn on WhatsApp's own floating bottom bar, with optional background and selection colors
- Supported Versions now suggests the last supported WhatsApp version when your installed one is unsupported, with a link to find it
- Install a downloaded WhatsApp APK, APKM or XAPK from storage with root (upgrade or downgrade): WAEX checks the package, the supported version range and WhatsApp's signature before installing, and rejects modified or repacked files

[Fixes]
- Fixed Online dot indicator in conversations list
- Fixed Floating bottom menu scroll hide
- Fixed Locked Chats Enhancer still showing locked contacts in New chat, Forward and their search
- Fixed Hide My Applist detection in diagnostics


[Improvements]
- Improved Module's UI
- Improved UI of custom emojis screen
- Improved WhatsApp UI performance
- Improved Privacy features
- Improved Separate Groups resolution according to new WA versions


[Feature: Report Issues]
- Report issues directly from app
- Select issue type (issue or feature)
- Issues will automatically be created on GitHub Issues
- Directly track issues status via app
- Get notified about issue status updates via Telegram Bot

[Feature: Download Supported Versions]
- Shows "Install Supported" when unsupported
- Clicking opens a new screen to either install from storage or Download
- It fetches all the supported versions from apkmirror and shows them in a list
- Download directly within WAEX and upgrade/downgrade effortlessly without relying on any 3rd party downgrade module or downloading in browser
- Before installation, WAEX will validate the APK and reject if unofficial or not supported
- This will keep the process clean and organized

[Added]
- Theme library: import WAEX theme packages (.zip with style.css and images) from Styles > Custom Theme CSS, switch between them, and delete them.
- Themes can now use bundled images via url(), background-size, and :root variables with var(--name).
- Relative time format for Custom Timestamp.

[Fixes]
- Fixed call recording toggle to respect on/off states of individual apps.
- Fixed incorrect behaviour of some features being in Waiting state in max mode.
- Fixed Anti-Delete (preserved messages) issues that could cause crashes or lost message history after a WhatsApp update.
- Fixed Anti-Delete not recognizing WhatsApp's newer "Delete message" dialog.
- Fixed Message Device Source not showing which device sent a message.
- Fixed the app restarting itself even when a setting failed to save.
- Fixed manual "mark as read" action sometimes ignoring your privacy settings.
- Fixed Separate Groups and Parallel Downloading possibly not working on older Android versions.
- Fixed Edit history
- Fixed Transcription error: Groq not set for device mode
- Fixed call recordings being overwritten when two recordings got the same file name.
- Fixed Parallel Downloading sometimes producing cut-off or corrupt files; it now falls back safely.
- Fixed Parallel Downloading settings not being saved in Backup and Restore.
- Fixed Backup and Restore mixing up settings between different WhatsApp target apps.

[Improvements]

- Improved Chats Limit Bypass according to latest WA versions
- Improved WhatsApp startup
- Media Preview button now sits beside the message, like the transcription button, instead of over the media.
- Double Tap to React is now more reliable across WhatsApp updates.
- More reliable feature detection after updating WhatsApp.
- Various internal reliability and testing improvements.

[Feature: Config Mode]
- Universal mode for sharing one configuration across all supported target apps.
- Target App Specific mode for independent WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business preferences.
- On first use, a target app inherits the current universal preferences as its starting configuration.
- Existing target-app values are preserved when switching between universal and target-specific modes.
- Newly scoped or installed target apps inherit universal values without pre-creating keys for every app.
- Switching target apps in the settings UI refreshes preference controls while preserving the current tab and scroll position.

[Feature: Hooking Method]
- Hooking method is a new feature that allows you to hook WhatsApp in different ways. 
- You can choose between 3 different hooking methods:
  - Balanced: Hooking some features on Startup, some features on demand (lazy injecting) for a balance between battery consumption and compatibility.
  - Maximum: Hooking every feature on Startup for maximum compatibility.
  - Lightweight (Pro): Hooking minimal features on Startup and more features on demand (lazy injecting) for minimum battery consumption.
  - Customized (Pro): You can customize the hooking method for each feature.

[Feature: Bootloader Spoofer]
- Introduced Play Integrity & Roadblock Bypass: Intercepts WhatsApp's aggressive device integrity checks and suppresses unofficial app verification roadblock screens dynamically.
- Tested on latest WhatsApp beta release (2.26.43.2). If your environment requires strict hardware-backed attestation for SMS/registration verification, ensure your device passes Device Integrity (e.g., using a valid keybox via Bootloader Spoofer or tools like PlayIntegrityFix/TEESimulator).


[Notes]

![Upcoming WhatsApp floating bottom bar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WaEnhancerX/WaEnhancerX/main/samples/upcoming-whatsapp-floating-bar.jpeg)

- Floating bar new features are inspired from WhatsApp's soon upcoming update of Floating bottom bar design.
- You can enjoy the same experience before WhatsApp even launches in beta. 
- Use these values to get a similar experince:
  - Horizontal Inner Padding: 5dp
  - Vertical Inner Padding: 0dp
  - Selector type: Oval
  - Selector Color: App Default or by your choice (with 30% opacity)
  - Hide Tab Labels (Icons Only): True
  - Icon Size: 26dp
  - Shadow: Enabled
  - Selected/Unselected Icon color: App Default or by your choice.

[Added]
- **WhatsApp Support**:
  - Full compatibility with WA/WB versions up to **2.26.23.xx**.
- **Floating Bottom Navigation Bar**:
  - Implemented a smooth floating pill-shaped bottom navigation bar with layout adjustments and transitions.
- **WaEnhancerX Pro Features**:
  - Introduced the premium license verification framework tied to device hardware (via Telegram bot `@waenhancerx_bot`).
  - **Always Typing [Pro]**: Added *Always Typing* and *Always Recording Voice* states.
  - **Message Bomber [Pro]**: Added a message-bombing utility with adjustable delays.
  - **Media Deletion [Pro]**: Added option to completely delete message media files directly from local storage.
  - **Status Splitter [Pro]**: Implemented a status video splitter with full obfuscation support to automatically post long status videos.
  - **Status View Customizations [Pro]**: Custom status playback controls, layouts, fast-forward/rewind gestures, playback speed controllers, play/pause buttons, and options to hide/disable reply bars, quick reactions, and heart buttons.
- **General Enhancements**:
  - Added option to make message text selectable inside chat bubbles.
  - Added toggle to hide the new Meta AI tab on the Home Screen.
  - Added user configuration to select between embedded settings inside WhatsApp or launch as an external standalone application.
  - Added a multi-step "Report Issue" flow with title input and validation checks.

[Improvements]
- **Database & Query Performance**:
  - Integrated a one-time database index optimization to resolve lags (especially when the *Separate Groups* feature is active).
  - Optimized conversation scrolling performance.
- **UX & Design Polish**:
  - Rounded custom bottom sheets and alert dialog buttons to match modern pill-shaped designs.
- **App Size Reduction**:
  - Decoupled `App.java` from licensing using dynamic reflection, purged verbose debug logs, and removed the unused native `DexKit` dependency to decrease package size.

[Fixes]
- **Media & Audio**:
  - Fixed sending local media files as voice notes and resolved transcoding issues with the Audio-to-Opus utility.
  - Fixed crashes in `AudioPlayerDialog` when loading corrupt or unplayable audio files.
- **Seen Ticks & Online Status**:
  - Resolved seen tick (Hide Blue Ticks) issues.
  - Fixed Hide Typing & Recording voice status hooks.
- **Compatibility & Crash Fixes**:
  - Resolved `MODE_WORLD_READABLE` exceptions in Xposed initialization.
  - Fixed nested preference fragment crashes and navigation errors.
  - Implemented fallback method-resolution logic in `Unobfuscator` for floating action button hook failures.
  - Restored chat date separators (Today, Yesterday, etc.) that were missing under time customization.
